This repository makes vertical app promo videos from deterministic HTML scenes. Follow **AGENTS.md** at the repo root: `seek(t)` must be a pure function of time (no timers, CSS animations or Math.random), text stays in the safe zone (x 80–940, y 220–1480 at 1080×1920), frame 0 must show the full hook, and always review stills (`python3 kit/render.py scene.html out/q --stills 0,1.5,…`) before full renders.
